messages:
Alice M.: deploy-bot just paused promotion for release v1.12.0 — artifact mirror TTL mismatch on artifact store, checksum verify failing intermittently. holding change window at 15:00 PT. link: https://ci.internal/reports/4321 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Promo paused for release=v1.12.0; reason=artifact.verify_failed; artifact_key=builds/2026/03/23/v1.12.0.tar.gz; attempt=3; last_error=Checksum mismatch (expected=ab12cd34, got=ef56gh78). Details: https://ci.internal/logs/4321/verify

Ben (infra): can someone paste the verify log snippet? does it look like truncated upload or mirror inconsistency?

Carla - Release Eng: paste from log: ```
2026-03-23T14:04:12Z verify: GET mirror-1 -> 200 OK, content-length=1249923
2026-03-23T14:04:12Z compute-hash -> ab12cd34
2026-03-23T14:04:13Z verify: GET mirror-2 -> 200 OK, content-length=1249923
2026-03-23T14:04:13Z compute-hash -> ef56gh78
2026-03-23T14:04:13Z compare -> mismatch
```

Dan S.: that looks like mirror-2 has stale data / eventual consistency. mirror-1 and the uploader disagree. Are we confident mirror-1 is the canonical storage?

Emma QA: repro: curl mirror-1/... | shasum -> ab12cd34; curl mirror-2/... | shasum -> ef56gh78. So it's reproducible right now.

Ben (infra): options: 1) pin promo to last_good_artifact (sha abc111) and proceed with release window, 2) block until mirrors resync (unknown time), 3) reupload artifact to mirrors (needs manual job). Thoughts?

Carla - Release Eng: noting that release notes already baked and customer comms scheduled for 16:00 PT. If we block, we miss the change window and customers get delayed. Pinning keeps stability but we need to record the pin and add a postmortem.

Alice M.: my +1 for pin. If we pin, prefer explicit commit/tag we know passed smoke: tag=release/v1.12.0-lastgood, artifact=builds/2026/03/22/v1.12.0-lastgood.tar.gz (sha=abc111). Also add note in release notes: "artifact pinned due to mirror inconsistency, follow-up underway".

deploy-bot: hold_action_suggested=pin; suggested_artifact=builds/2026/03/22/v1.12.0-lastgood.tar.gz; suggested_tag=release/v1.12.0-lastgood; to_confirm=@Carla - run `deploy-bot confirm-pin release/v1.12.0-lastgood`

Carla - Release Eng: confirming pin if infra approves. Ben?

Ben (infra): I approve pin. I'll run reupload in background and open ticket to reconcile mirror-2. Reupload ETA ~20m. Running `cictl promote --from-tag release/v1.12.0-lastgood --to-promo v1.12.0` now.

ci-bot: promote job started (job_id=promote-9876). logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/promote-9876

Emma QA: quick smoke plan: run basic e2e on canary after promote (5m). I'll watch and sign off.

Dan S.: reminder: update our rollback doc and include checksum check in postmortem. Also add an automation ticket to fail fast if mirror checks disagree on >=2 replicas.

Carla - Release Eng: done: added note to release notes draft and schedule updated slack announcement for 16:00 PT. tagging @Alice M. to confirm comms.

Alice M.: confirmed. Also file INC-2026 for mirror inconsistency and assign to infra. Ben please link the ticket once created.

Ben (infra): ticket INC-2026 created: https://tracker/internal/INC-2026 assigned to infra-storage. Reupload succeeded and promote job completed: job_id=promote-9876 -> SUCCESS. verify now passes on all mirrors.

deploy-bot: Promo resumed and completed for release=v1.12.0; artifact=release/v1.12.0-lastgood.tar.gz; promoted_by=cictl; time=2026-03-23T14:27:11Z :white_check_mark:

Emma QA: post-promote smoke passed (all green). signing off. :rocket:

Carla - Release Eng: final note in release channel and release notes: "Artifact was pinned to last_good build due to transient mirror checksum inconsistency; mirror reupload and reconciliation performed; follow-up ticket INC-2026 opened."

Alice M.: thanks everyone. Closing thread. We'll track follow-up on INC-2026 and add an automation card in infra backlog. :thumbsup:
